title: Day 9: an AI made mahjong where your hand is dinner #shorts
description:
Mahjong where your winning hand is tonight's dinner.

Menu Mahjong is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Tiles are ingredients and sets are dishes: pork, ginger and soy make ginger pork, a pair of rice is your staple. Draw one, discard one, and when four dishes and a staple come together you call Tsumo. Your win becomes tonight's menu, with recipes and a shopping list. One shared hand a day, the same deal for everyone.

Menu Mahjong - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 10 tomorrow.

#mahjong #cooking #dinnerideas #puzzle #indiegame
